title: capsella prorepens var. yezoensis
intro: Capsella prorepens var. yezoensis, commonly known as Japanese peppercress, is a plant species of the mustard family, Brassicaceae, native to Japan and Korea. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from colds and coughs due to its expectorant and mucolytic properties, as well as its anti-inflammatory effects that help soothe respiratory issues. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Japanese peppercress include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate congestion, and promote digestion, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health ailments.
